C10 (every sending call left its notice in the outbox): a confirmed call does not prove a row was written, because a preview call is also confirmed under the same label and appends no row. Only trace of a call, on named lines at A3, can show it. At 10 per line, the allowance of 50 covers 5 of the 100 sends, so I wanted an outbox-wide check for the whole release. 3. C5 (the worker reads only approved accounts): only scope of a call checks this, and only on named lines. Checking the list read plus 100 account reads (101 lines) is far beyond the allowance, so I wanted a plan-level scope check over every read. 4. A check of the live tables after the promotion: same set and summary of the change read only the staged set as it was kept. Only the promotion's line in the record ties the live tables to it.
